text.7:185: Have they not considered the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and what things Allah hath created, and that it may be that their own term draweth nigh? In what fact after this will they believe?
text.21:1: Their reckoning draweth nigh for mankind, while they turn away in heedlessness.
text.21:97: And the True Promise draweth nigh; then behold them, staring wide (in terror), the eyes of those who disbelieve! (They say): Alas for us! We (lived) in forgetfulness of this. Ah, but we were wrong-doers!
text.54:1: The hour drew nigh and the moon was rent in twain.
text.96:19: Nay, Obey not thou him. But prostrate thyself, and draw near (unto Allah).
